svg.title: How it works: seven steps from one request to a verdict
svg.desc: Seven steps along a path. One, did they ask: read the request in any language, with AI. Two, who are they: find every email they ever used. Three, read it all: databases, logs, PDFs and screenshots, with AI for pictures. Four, link records: exact matches only. Five, what was true: snapshots from before audit day. Six, apply policy: delete, redact, anonymize or keep, with AI to name record types. Seven, verdict and plan: find, fix, then check. AI is used only where reading needs judgment; everything else is plain, testable code.
svg.text: From one request to a verdict
Seven steps. Each one hands a little more evidence to the next.
= an AI model helps with this step
AI only where reading needs judgment. Everything else is plain, testable code.
